verdict.rationale: Manufact's own API-keys documentation says keys authenticate programmatic access from "the REST API, CI pipelines, and scripts," so a public REST API exists by first-party claim. That is the only mention: no endpoint reference or schema appears in the pack, and probes for an OpenAPI/Swagger spec at the usual paths all returned 404. The official MCP server and CLI are separate interfaces and are not credited here. Missing for 10: a documented REST API reference (endpoints, resources, request/response shapes), a published OpenAPI spec, coverage details on which operations the API can drive, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: API keys authenticate programmatic access to your organization, from the REST API, CI pipelines, and scripts.
